gatheringstorm.name: Gathering Storm
gatheringstorm.desc: Every 10 min gain AP or AD, adaptive . 10 min : + 8 AP or 5 AD 20 min : + 24 AP or 14 AD 30 min : + 48 AP or 29 AD 40 min : + 80 AP or 48 AD 50 min : + 120 AP or 72 AD 60 min : + 168 AP or 101 AD etc...

presenceofmind.name: Presence of Mind
presenceofmind.desc: Damaging an enemy champion restores 6-50 (80% for ranged) mana or 6 energy. Takedowns restore 15% of your maximum mana or energy. Cooldown for damage restoration: 8s

legendalacrity.name: Legend: Alacrity
legendalacrity.desc: Gain 3% attack speed plus an additional 1.5% for every Legend stack ( max 10 stacks ). Earn progress toward Legend stacks for every champion takedown, epic monster takedown, large monster kill, and minion kill.

hextechflashtraption.name: Hextech Flashtraption
hextechflashtraption.desc: While Flash is on cooldown it is replaced by Hexflash . Hexflash : Channel for 2s to blink to a new location. Cooldown: 20s. Goes on a 10s cooldown when you enter champion combat.

deathfiretouch.name: Deathfire Touch
deathfiretouch.desc: Damaging a champion with an ability burns them for 3 - 12 based on level (+ 2.5% AP ) (+ 7% bonus AD ) magic damage per second. After burning for 3 seconds, the damage of the burn increases by 75% while they remain on fire. Duration: Single Target: 4s Area of Effect: 2s Damage over Time: 1s

guardian.name: Guardian
guardian.desc: Guard allies within 350 units of you, and allies you target with spells for 2.5s. While Guarding , if you or the ally take more than a small amount of damage over the duration of the Guard , both of you gain a shield for 1.5s. Cooldown: 75 - 40 seconds Shield: 40 - 150 + 20% of your ability power + 6% of your bonus health Proc Threshold: 50 - 165 postmitigation damage

eyeballcollection.name: Eyeball Collection
eyeballcollection.desc: Collect eyeballs for champion takedowns. Gain an adaptive bonus of 1.2 Attack Damage or 2 Ability Power, per eyeball collected. Upon completing your collection at 10 eyeballs, additionally gain an adaptive bonus of 6 Attack Damage, or 10 Ability Power. Collect 1 eyeball per champion takedown.

grislymementos.name: Grisly Mementos
grislymementos.desc: Collect 1 memento on champion takedowns , up to 18 total. Gain 6 Trinket Haste for each collected. In game modes where vision Trinkets do not exist, instead gain 3 Summoner Spell Haste.

suddenimpact.name: Sudden Impact
suddenimpact.desc: Damaging basic attacks and abilities deal a bonus 20 - 80 True Damage based on level to enemy champions after using a dash, leap, blink, teleport, or when leaving stealth for 4s. Cooldown: 10s

biscuitdelivery.name: Biscuit Delivery
biscuitdelivery.desc: Biscuit Delivery: Gain a Total Biscuit of Everlasting Will every 2 mins, until 6 min. Biscuits restore 20 + 2% of your maximum health, increased by up to 100% based on missing Health. Consuming or selling a Biscuit permanently increases your max health by 30.

secondwind.name: Second Wind
secondwind.desc: After taking damage from an enemy champion, heal for 4% of your missing health over 10s.

graspoftheundying.name: Grasp of the Undying
graspoftheundying.desc: Every 4s in combat, your next basic attack on a champion will: Deal bonus magic damage equal to 3.5% of your max health Heal you for 1.3% of your max health Permanently increase your health by 5 Ranged Champions: Damage, healing, and permanent health gained are 40% effective.

hailofblades.name: Hail of Blades
hailofblades.desc: Gain 90% (60% for ranged champions) Attack Speed and bonus true damage when you attack an enemy champion for up to 3 attacks. No more than 3s can elapse between attacks or this effect will end. Cooldown: 10s. On-Hit Damage: 2 - 20 (+0.12 bonus AD, +0.1 AP) damage. Attack resets increase the attack limit by 1. Allows you to temporarily exceed the Attack Speed limit.

conditioning.name: Conditioning
conditioning.desc: After 12 min gain +8 Armor and +8 Magic Resist and increase your Armor and Magic Resist by 3%.

predator.name: Predator
predator.desc: Enchants your boots with the active effect ' Predator .' Gain increased Move Speed, ramping up to 25-50% Move Speed over 1 second, while chasing enemy champions. After ramping up, damaging attacks or abilities to champions end this effect, dealing 20-180 (+ 0.25 bonus AD)(+ 0.15 AP) bonus adaptive damage . Cooldown: 120s-60s.

absolutefocus.name: Absolute Focus
absolutefocus.desc: While above 70% health, gain an adaptive bonus of up to 18 Attack Damage or 30 Ability Power (based on level). Grants 1.8 Attack Damage or 3 Ability Power at level 1.

zombieward.name: Zombie Ward
zombieward.desc: Takedowns on enemy Wards cause friendly Zombie Wards to sprout from their corpses. Zombie Wards are visible, last for 120s and do not count towards your ward limit. Gain an adaptive bonus of 1.2 Attack Damage or 2 Ability Power for every Zombie Ward spawned, up to 10. After spawning 10 Zombie Wards, additionally gain 10 adaptive force.

chrysalis.name: Chrysalis
chrysalis.desc: Start the game with 40 bonus health. When you get 4 takedowns, convert that health for an adaptive bonus of 6 Attack Damage or 10 Ability Power.

jackofalltrades.name: Jack Of All Trades
jackofalltrades.desc: For each different stat gained from items, gain one Jack stack. Each stack grants you 1 Ability Haste . Gain 8 or 20 bonus Adaptive Force at 5 and 10 stacks, respectively.

arcanecomet.name: Arcane Comet
arcanecomet.desc: Damaging a champion with an ability hurls a comet at their location, dealing increased damage based on distance. Adaptive Damage : 15 - 100 based on level ( +0.05 AP and +0.1 bonus AD ) Cooldown: 20 - 8s Damage amplification scales up to 100% at 750 range.

cashback.name: Cash Back
cashback.desc: Get 7.5% Gold back when you purchase Legendary Items.
